description: Use when checking what changed at a place between two dates (construction, deforestation, flooding, crops). Input: lat, lon, radius_m (200-10000), before and after dates (20+ days apart). Output: JSON per date: clearest scene, area cloud %, NDVI mean/median, true color, NDVI and false color PNG URLs; NDVI change and reliability. No scene: 404, not charged. Example: ?lat=37.5665&lon=126.978&before=2026-04-15&after=2026-10-08 Price: $0.018 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

after.description: Later date YYYY-MM-DD, at least 20 days after before

radius_m.description: Half-width of the square area in meters (default 2000)

name: satellite_compare
title: Satellite before/after: two clearest Sentinel-2 scenes, images and NDVI change for any place
